datasets.purpose: IPC Classification spatial data in different IPC scenarios collected by FEWS NET enumerators on a regular schedule (typically monthly).

lineage.description: FEWS NET enumerators collected IPC classification data on a monthly schedule throughout 2012 for Djibouti. The classifications were spatially mapped to administrative units and compiled into geographic datasets representing four near-term projection periods (January, April, July, October). The data reflects food insecurity impact assessments in response to drought conditions.
